title: EvidenceRank
description: For each BOQ line, a ranking of the candidate drawing evidence supplied with it, each with a score, a reason, and whether it is selected as belonging to that line. The model may only refer to candidates it was given (by ref); it cannot introduce evidence, quantities or actions. Every choice is a proposal that an estimator accepts or overrides.

id.description: The id of the BOQ line, copied exactly from the input.

ranked.description: Every supplied candidate for this line, best first.

ref.description: The candidate ref exactly as supplied.

score.description: How well this evidence corresponds to the BOQ line (1 = certainly the same thing).

selected.description: True if this evidence should be counted toward the BOQ line's quantity.

reason.description: One short sentence: why it matches or does not (layer, size, material, trade, legend).
